description: Source code for a backend PCAP writer class that handles writing network packet data to PCAP files, including managing UDP headers, task execution, and file operations.

classes.name: pcap_pdu_data
classes.description: Represents a network Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with UDP header and payload data.

classes.name: backend_pcap_writer
classes.description: Handles writing network PDUs to PCAP files with support for flushing, closing, and queuing PDUs.

methods.name: pcap_pdu_data::pcap_pdu_data
methods.description: Constructor that creates a UDP header and assembles the PDU data.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::backend_pcap_writer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PCAP writer with file and layer details.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::~backend_pcap_writer
methods.description: Destructor that ensures the PCAP writer is closed.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::flush
methods.description: Flushes the PCAP data to disk if writing is enabled.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::flush_impl
methods.description: Implementation of flush that calls the writer's flush method.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::close
methods.description: Closes the PCAP writer, dispatching the close operation to the backend executor.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_pdu
methods.description: Queues a byte buffer PDU for writing if enabled.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_pdu
methods.description: Queues a pcap_pdu_data object for writing if enabled.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_pdu_impl
methods.description: Performs the actual writing of a byte buffer PDU to the file.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_context_pdu_impl
methods.description: Writes a pcap_pdu_data object, including headers and payload, to the file.
